Carla Nguyen: Short sync: need a compact spec for catalog lifecycle lanes so PM + sales can commit timelines without hand-holding.
Ethan Brooks: Agreed. Sales asked for a simple set: QUICK, NORMAL, HOLD. Each lane needs opt-in windows, incentives, and clear rollback/playbook.
Priya K.: Proposal for lanes:
- QUICK: 0-21d, concierge migration, stricter gates
- NORMAL: 22-60d, self-serve, standard gates
- HOLD: contract-only, manual migration
Sam Wheeler: Gate categories: perf, quality, cost, compatibility, safety. Each gate = metric + allowed delta + harness. Example: intent_f1_drop <= 2% (NORMAL), p95 <= 180ms (NORMAL), cost_delta <= +12%.
Dina Ops: Ops checklist (automatable where possible): tokenizer checksum match, kv-cache schema check, perf smoke at 1x and 3x QPS, fallback model available. Human stop if tokenizer mismatch.
Priya K.: Safety gate: define critical prompt set (~60). If safety_regression_ratio > 1.25 OR any high-sev safety trigger goes from 0->1 -> fail and rollback. Also a hallucination signal: if hallucination_rate > 1.4x baseline -> fail.
Ethan Brooks: Pin policy: permanent pin only with enterprise addendum and flag pin_locked. Otherwise soft-pin = 90d. Need billing hook and contract language.
Carla Nguyen: Draft rollout config to wire into Console:
```
rollout:
  lanes:
    - name: QUICK
      initial_pct: 10
      duration_hours: 24
      monitors: [latency_p95, eval_delta, safety_regression]
    - name: NORMAL
      initial_pct: 5
      ramp_to: 20
      duration_hours: 96
      monitors: [latency_p95, eval_delta]
  auto_rollback:
    triggers: [eval_delta_exceed, safety_regression_exceed]
    fallback: family-x-compat
```
migrate-bot: queued: run "catalog-lane-smoke" on ded-cluster-9, eta 5250001270
Sam Wheeler: Need comms cadence templates: pre-notice 21/7 days, canary 72h, final 14d sunset. QUICK opt-ins allowed only first 14d of canary. Also draft a simple FAQ for "what if my app breaks" linking rollback runbook.
Dina Ops: telemetry: include tags migration_lane, pinned_from, pinned_to, rollout_id, fallback_used; export pre/post eval snapshots for audits. Also capture request_id and model_variant for each request.
migrate-bot: run complete: median 110ms, p95 162ms, intent_f1_drop 1.6%, safety_regression_ratio 1.02 -> PASS for NORMAL lane gates
Carla Nguyen: Nice. Owners: Priya -> eval harness + critical prompt set; Dina -> console defaults + rollback variant + telemetry; Ethan -> pin policy + contract text; Sam -> comm templates + sales playbook. Target PRs: Priya 5250001260, Dina 5250001275, Ethan 5250001280, Sam 5250001285. If all green we'll merge canary config 09:00 PT tomorrow. Keep updates here. :rocket:
